text:
Quantum computers could one day transform fusion energy, chemistry, and drug discovery - if we can make the algorithms efficient enough to run on early hardware.

Using teams of Gemini 4 agents, we’ve built new quantum circuits that cut future simulation costs by up to 10 times.

Gemini 4 Hydrogen built an interactive 3D globe that turns live lightning strikes into ambient music.

Try it here →

Gemini 4 Neon recreated Alan Turing’s 1936 study at @Cambridge_Uni in interactive 3D.

Using archival photos in @Antigravity, the model built Room X.8 at King’s College with a running Universal Turing Machine.

Gemini 4 Neon coded a ski simulator based on real Mont Blanc terrain.

Built in @Antigravity with custom shaders and zero pre-made 3D models, it renders carved snow and avalanches live.

Try it now →

Gemini 4 Hydrogen turned Google Sheets into a pixel-art canvas.

Using @Antigravity, the model shrank thousands of cells to create animated scenes.
